charges.label: Base freight (per km, by billed weight band)
charges.quote: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, according to the consignment's billed weight: up to and including 500 kg: Rs18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: Rs24.00 per km. Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium (15% of base freight)
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge (12% of base freight plus express premium)
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery flat charge
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): Rs250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; each credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date. Disputed line items are payable only on resolution; undisputed items remain due.

ambiguities.description: The base freight weight bands are 'up to and including 500 kg' (Rs18/km) and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' (Rs24/km). If billed_weight_kg can carry a fractional value, the open interval strictly greater than 500 kg and strictly less than 501 kg is not covered by either band and is left undetermined rather than assumed into one tier.

notes: Ambiguity: §1's weight bands ('up to and including 500 kg' then '501 kg to 2,000 kg') leave the open interval (500, 501) kg uncovered if billed_weight_kg is fractional; left as an ambiguity rather than assigned to a tier. Weights above 2,000 kg are encoded as out_of_card per §1 ('quoted case by case ... outside this rate card'), not priced. §2/§5 give no name for the carrier's default (non-express) service; 'standard' is used as the natural complement to the contract's named 'Express service' since the field only allows express/standard. No invoice-level discounts or volume adjustments are stated in the contract, so invoice_adjustments is empty. §5 makes the accessorial schedule closed: only residential delivery (§4) is payable; anything else requires a separate written rate confirmation and is out of scope for this spec.
